text: 金十数据7月21日讯，7月21日，无隅资产发布公告称，基于对中国资本市场长期发展以及对于公司投资策略的信心，公司于近期使用自有资金人民币1000万元，申购公司旗下私募证券投资基金产品。
text_en: Jin10 Data July 21 - On July 21, WuYu Asset announced that, based on confidence in the long-term development of China's capital market and its own investment strategy, the company recently used its own funds of 10 million yuan to subscribe to its private securities investment fund products.
